welle_e3b.frist.zuSpaet: Too late for this election: it is in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, and the vote would come after {abstimmung} days at the earliest.
welle_e3b.frist.nurDirekt: The election is in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}: only with {direkt} votes does the package take effect in time. With a referendum it takes {referendum} days.
welle_e3b.frist.eingebrachtZuSpaet: It comes too late for the election in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}: you will not be on that ballot.
welle_e3b.art116.log: Early election under Art. 116(3): you may run once more
welle_e3b.art116.warum: Parliament renewed the election during your last term. The exception applies once.
welle_e3b.titel.2: {monate} months to the election in which you cannot run
welle_e3b.titel.3: {monate} months left: the election without you is approaching
welle_e3b.text1: This is your term no. {nr}; the constitution allows {max}. You may not run in the election on {datum, date}.
welle_e3b.text2.offen: Who will run for your camp is still open.
welle_e3b.warum: Art. 101 of the constitution: no one can be elected president more than twice. Changing that takes time and votes.
welle_e3b.weg.lockern.label.wiederwahl_p: Amend the constitution: one more re-election
welle_e3b.weg.lockern.label.unbegrenzt: Amend the constitution: no term limit
welle_e3b.weg.lockern.beschr: A constitutional package on this article alone. In parliament, possibly in court and at the ballot box.
welle_e3b.weg.lockern.zahlen: Needed: {mehrheit} votes, then a referendum ({referendum} days), or {direkt} votes ({tage} days). Expected: {erwartet} ({tief} to {hoch})
welle_e3b.weg.wahl: Election in {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
welle_e3b.weg.neuwahl.label: Early election by parliament (Art. 116)
welle_e3b.weg.neuwahl.beschr: If parliament calls new elections during your last term, you may run once more. The vote takes place within two months.
welle_e3b.weg.neuwahl.zahlen: Needed: {mehrheit} votes (three fifths), no referendum, vote after {tage} days. Expected: {erwartet} ({tief} to {hoch})
welle_e3b.weg.aufbauen.label: Build up your successor
welle_e3b.weg.aufbauen.beschr: You let the contenders work in the open. The party sees an orderly transition.
welle_e3b.weg.aufbauen.beschr_name: You put {name} at your side. The party sees an orderly transition.
welle_e3b.weg.abtreten.label: Announce you will step down
welle_e3b.weg.abtreten.beschr: You declare publicly that you will respect the limit and not run again.
welle_e3b.weg.abtreten.zahlen: Legitimacy {leg}, standing {ansehen}, trust {vertrauen}, each minister’s loyalty {kabinett}
welle_e3b.weg.spaeter.label: Decide later
